newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: British tourist beaten to death at Bondi Beach.
newsitem.headline: British tourist beaten to death at Bondi Beach.

text.p: A British tourist was beaten to death at Bondi Beach in front of his girlfriend, who frantically fought the two attackers, police said on Saturday.
Police sniffer dogs were on brought in Saturday to follow a trail of blood from the scene to a nearby nightspot. Police said they believed the blood trail was that of one of the attackers.
The attack occurred at 12.30 a.m. (0230 GMT) on Saturday in a well-lit, busy street just off Campbell Parade, the main street that runs along Bondi Beach, police said.
Brian Hagland, 28, from London, and his unidentified, 25-year-old girlfriend had just gotten off a bus, police said.

"The couple were walking home when they came across two men walking the other way. An argument developed and the British man was set upon. They kicked him in the head and body before running off towards Bondi Beach," a police spokesman said.
"The man's girlfried tried to protect him, hitting the two attackers with her bag and screaming for help," he said.
Hagland was treated at the scene by ambulance officers before being taken to hospital where he died a short time later.
Hagland and his girlfriend had been in Australia for eight months and had been due to leave for New Zealand in a few weeks.
